claims.text: The Dewberry borders Marion Square, a public park that hosts some of the city's most popular events.

findings.quote: Bordering Charleston’s Marion Square, a treasured public park and setting for some of the city’s most popular events

claims.text: The hotel occupies Charleston's L. Mendel Rivers Federal Building (circa 1964), a mid-century modern landmark rescued, restored and reimagined by owner John Dewberry.

findings.quote: Honoring the history of Charleston’s landmark L. Mendel Rivers Federal Building (circa 1964), The Dewberry is a mid-century modern landmark _rescued, restored,_ and _reimagined_ by visionary owner John Dewberry.

claims.text: The building was reimagined over eight years by a team of architects and designers.

findings.quote: The Dewberry was reimagined over eight years by a team of renowned architects and designers

claims.text: Design details include hand-gilded cranes in the Swanston Room, custom botanical armoires, Vermont-selected marble, vintage Danish furnishings and a bespoke Woka brass chandelier.

findings.quote: from hand-gilded cranes in the Swanston Room to custom botanical armoires, Vermont-selected marble, vintage Danish furnishings, and a bespoke Woka brass chandelier

claims.text: Rooms have custom Stickley armoires with botanical patterns, baths of Vermont marble, mattresses imported from Ireland and chef-curated mini-bars.

findings.quote: from custom Stickley armoires with botanical patterns and spa-like baths of Vermont marble to sumptuous mattresses imported from Ireland to chef-curated mini-bars

claims.text: The Charleston Flats sit in the corners of each floor.

findings.quote: our light-filled Charleston Flats take their rightful place in the corners of each floor

claims.text: The extraordinarily tall windows date to when JFK originally commissioned the building.

findings.quote: Extraordinarily tall windows date to when JFK originally commissioned this building

claims.text: The Spa is softly lit, cypress lined and curtain draped, and offers Natura Bisse facials, hot river stone massages and detoxifying seaweed wraps.

findings.quote: The Spa is softly lit, cypress lined, curtain draped
From Natura Bissé facials, to hot river stone massages, to detoxifying seaweed wraps

claims.text: Complimentary Volvo house car transportation is offered to select destinations in downtown Charleston, based on availability.

findings.quote: Complimentary Volvo house car transportation is offered for select destinations in downtown Charleston, based on availability.

claims.text: The hotel has a fleet of 21-gear Specialized bicycles with racks and baskets for cruising around the peninsula.

findings.quote: Complete with racks and baskets, our fleet of premier 21-gear Specialized bicycles are perfect for cruising around the peninsula.

claims.text: Hotel guests can book a privately guided introduction to The Charleston Library Society.

findings.quote: hotel guests will have an opportunity to secure a privately guided introduction to The Charleston Library Society

claims.text: The Dewberry was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards every year from 2017 to 2026.
The John Derian Flat blends Derian's signature decoupage pieces with vintage-inspired goods and textiles.

findings.quote: The John Derian Flat design is a beautiful blend of Derian’s signature decoupage pieces, and vintage-inspired goods and textiles

claims.text: The Dewberry is the exclusive Charleston hotel partner of Barton & Gray, so guests can charter a classic Hinckley Talaria yacht to see Charleston and the barrier islands from the water.

findings.quote: We’re delighted to be the exclusive Charleston hotel partner of Barton & Gray
Experience Charleston and the barrier islands from the waterways aboard a classic Hinckley Talaria.

claims.text: One-Bedroom Suites have a separate bedroom with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Historic Charleston and Marion Square.

findings.quote: A separate, sun-filled bedroom has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Historic Charleston and Marion Square.

claims.text: Citrus Club occupies the hotel's eighth-floor terrace and is the highest rooftop lounge in Charleston, with 360-degree views over the peninsula.

findings.quote: the Citrus Club occupies The Dewberry’s eighth floor terrace and features the highest rooftop lounge in Charleston
head high to the rooftop cocktail lounge, Citrus Club, for 360-degree views over the peninsula

claims.text: The concierge can schedule a five-hour beach trip in a Volvo house car, packed with beach chairs, an umbrella, towels and cold waters.

findings.quote: in the comfort of our Volvo XC90 Recharge house cars, thoughtfully packed for you with all the essentials
schedule your five-hour beach trip, with everything you need — from premium beach chairs and an umbrella to a beach bag filled with plush towels and cold waters

claims.text: Parking is valet only, at $58 per night; self-parking is not offered.

findings.quote: Valet parking is available for $58 per night; self-parking is not offered.

claims.text: Pets are not permitted, though service animals are welcome, and rollaway beds are not available; cribs can be arranged through the Concierge.

findings.quote: Pets are not permitted, but service animals are welcome in accordance with ADA guidelines.
Rollaway beds are not available. Cribs and Pack ’n Plays can be arranged via the Concierge, subject to availability.

claims.text: Citrus Club, the rooftop lounge, is for guests 21 and older.

findings.quote: Citrus Club is for guests 21 years of age and older.
